**About the role:**

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) provides field\-based medical/scientific expertise, ensuring appropriate understanding of the disease area and Biogen’s products, where relevant. As a key scientific interface between Biogen and the external medical community in the assigned territory, the MSL is integral to building valued and constructive partnerships with key stakeholders across the medical community and the healthcare system.


MSLs contribute to company success through internal and external medical education, medical/scientific information exchange and support, as well as by using their scientific expertise to gather medical insights and support research/data\-generation initiatives. Through field excellence, collaboration and sound understanding of the local healthcare environment, the MSL helps ensure that external perspectives are appropriately considered within Medical Affairs planning.


Operating with customer focus, clear commitment to ethics, quality and compliance, the MSL contributes to Biogen’s mission to advance scientific understanding and support improved outcomes for patients.


**Main accountabilities** :


* Engages in high\-quality scientific/medical exchange with HCPs and relevant stakeholders as appropriate, in line with local requirements, regulations and Biogen policies.
* Supports reactive scientific discussions within the product label and, where appropriate, broader disease\-area dialogue, wider medical/scientific literature exchange and legitimate interactions related to medicines in development.
* Gathers, interprets and shares medical insights from medical experts and thought leaders to inform Medical Affairs activities, lifecycle management, investigational compounds and potential research/data\-generation opportunities.
* Maintains up\-to\-date knowledge of therapy advances, current research, Biogen products and relevant disease areas, ensuring scientific discussions are accurate, balanced and aligned with the evolving treatment landscape.
* May support Medical Research activities and clinical research\-related interactions, in collaboration with Global Clinical Development Operations and other relevant functions, within agreed governance boundaries.
* Collaborates appropriately with internal functions, including Medical, Value \& Access, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing and Care Managers, to ensure aligned medical execution and effective cross\-functional contribution.
* Provides medical and scientific support to HCPs and other stakeholders who wish to present data on Biogen disease areas and related products, ensuring compliant scientific presentations and appropriate data dissemination.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

* BSc in a relevant scientific discipline required; advanced terminal degree preferred, such as MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Desired minimum 2\+ years’ experience in one of the as a high\-specialty therapeutic areas (rare diseases, neurological disorders, genetics, Neurology, Immunology/Dermatology and/or Hematology from Medical Affairs, the pharmaceutical industry or medical practice.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and communicate complex medical information effectively.
* Understanding of health economics and of the pharmaceutical environment, including the role of Medical Affairs within the healthcare system is desirable.
* Technical knowledge in relevant therapeutic areas, with the ability to interpret, discuss and communicate complex scientific and clinical data in a clear, accurate and balanced manner.
* Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, including overnight and occasional weekend travel.
* Proven ability to work within local regulations, codes of practice and company policies, with strong interpersonal, communication, planning and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong strategic planning and insight generation skills.
* Proficiency in English with fluent proficiency preferred.

All relevant information is available on the Company's website at: https://www.biogenitalia.it/responsabilita\-sociale/reporting\-e\-principi.html **.**

title: Research Contracts Associate
description:
Fondazione Telethon is a major Italian charity focused on rare genetic diseases. Founded in 1990, its mission is to advance biomedical research towards the cure of genetic diseases with the ultimate goal of making new therapies available to patients in need. Fondazione Telethon has 3\.186 projects for an overall amount of 790 million Euro , both within its own research institutes (Tigem and SR\-Tiget) and through grants to Italian academic institutions, with the purpose of progressing research from the lab bench to the patient bedside and has secured critical competences for such purpose, including translational research management, regulatory, quality and CMC expertise, clinical operation and business development. Since 2023 Fondazione Telethon is also holder of the marketing authorization in Europe for Strimvelis and in Europe and United States for Waskyra, both ex vivo gene therapy for ultrarare immunodeficiencies.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to join our Intellectual Property \& Business Development Team.


The Business Development Office has the purpose of supporting the research groups in order to generate new therapeutic/diagnostic products, facilitating access to third parties’ know\-how and technologies, as well as supporting the development of such therapeutic/diagnostic products through mutually successful partnerships with industries and investors.

  

The resource will be responsible for supporting the management, negotiation, and coordination of contractual agreements related to research activities, technology transfer initiatives, and R\&D collaborations with external partners, ensuring the protection of Fondazione Telethon’s intellectual property and scientific interests.

  


  

**Posizione:**
--------------

**RESPONSABILITIES:**

  

* Draft, review, negotiate and manage Confidential Disclosure Agreements (CDAs);
* Draft, review, negotiate and manage Research Agreements involving intellectual property considerations, including Material Transfer Agreements (MTAs), Data Transfer Agreements (DTAs), Service Agreements, and Consultancy Agreements;
* Review and ensure the proper management of intellectual property rights and ownership clauses related to research results within contracts managed by other internal departments that have IP and/or Business Development implications;
* Coordinate internally with Research \& Development, Legal Affairs, Finance, Grant Office, and Tigem’s and SR\-Tiget’s teams, including researchers and administrative staff;
* Manage relationships and negotiations with external counterparties, including academic institutions, research organizations, companies, and service providers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for and collaborate with external legal counsel, where required, on specialized matters and contractual issues related to the areas mentioned above.
* Monitor legal updates, and relevant case law affecting the contractual activities under management.
* Contribute to the drafting and review of policies related to intellectual property, business development operations, and associated contractual and strategic matters, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and best practices.

**Requisiti:**
--------------

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* Master’s Degree in Law;
* At least 2 years of experience in Intellectual Property, Technology Transfer, Research Contracts, or related legal matters, gained within an IP department of a law firm, a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or research\-driven organization.
* Familiarity with biological sciences, research environments, and laboratory settings, with the ability to understand the scientific, technical, and operational context in which research collaborations and innovation activities take place.
* Solid understanding of intellectual property rights, confidentiality obligations, research collaborations, and contractual matters related to innovation and technology transfer.
* Experience in drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing agreements involving intellectual property and research activities.
* Ability to effectively interact with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including researchers, scientific personnel, administrative staff, legal advisors, and external partners.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to identify and mitigate contractual and intellectual property risks.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Professional proficiency in both Italian and English, with the ability to draft and negotiate legal and contractual documentation in both languages.

**Altre informazioni:**
-----------------------

**WHY JOIN FONDAZIONE TELETHON?**

* We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of rare patients;
* You will work with leading scientists in top ranking research institutes and contribute to the development of breakthrough science in an industry\-oriented setting;

At IQVIA, our Regulatory Affairs teams help pharmaceutical clients navigate regulatory requirements and maintain medicinal products on the market.

You will take ownership of routine operational activities, interact with clients and health authorities, and help ensure that regulatory deliverables are completed accurately and on time.  


Contract: Fixed\-term maternity cover

Support the regulatory lifecycle management of medicinal products on the Italian market.  
Prepare, review and coordinate regulatory documentation and submissions.  
Support submissions and routine communications with Italian health authorities.  
Work with clients to understand requests, coordinate activities and meet regulatory and contractual deadlines.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in pharmacy, biology, biotechnology or another relevant life\-sciences discipline.

title: Technical Product Manager - Italy
description:
Evolus (Nasdaq: EOLS) is a performance beauty company with a customer\-centric approach focused on delivering breakthrough products. Evolus International is the fastest\-growing business unit. That growth only works if we build a Digital ecosystem that can flex across markets, brands, customers, business models, and regulations.


Our International Digital ecosystem covers marketing sites, brand sites, B2B ecommerce channels, internal sales tools, CRM, and the digital capabilities that support marketing, sales, customer support, and operations across every country we serve.


We are seeking an experienced, driven Technical Product Manager to join our Digital Engineering Team, reporting to the Executive Director, Digital and Engineering. You will be embedded in the international business and act as the bridge between our business teams and Digital Engineering. You will take real business problems, turn them into clear product and technical requirements, and drive them through to delivery with designers, engineers, vendors, and stakeholders across the business. This is not a project coordinator role, and it is not a traditional business analyst role. You will own real product decisions, carry real accountability for execution, and be expected to shape how our international ecommerce experience grows. One day you might be presenting a roadmap to senior leadership. The next you might be writing detailed user stories with an engineer. Both are part of the job.


If you join our team, you will be working on some of the most exciting opportunities and challenges we face, with a team that values growth, recognition, and camaraderie. If you are looking for an opportunity to exhibit your knowledge and technical abilities in a unique environment, then look no further! In this role, you will be challenged to drive the success of Evolus in an effort to build a brand like no other

* Run structured discovery with Country General Managers, sales teams, marketing, operations, and customer support to understand what is and is not working
* Map the current e\-commerce customer journey and pinpoint what is holding back adoption
* Turn business problems into clear requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting documentation
* Own and maintain the product backlog and the International Digital roadmap
* Build program plans that cover milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and release sequencing
* Work with designers and engineers from early discovery through launch

* This role is based in Milan International Headquarters and follows a hybrid model, with mandatory Tuesdays to Thursdays in the office. Applicants must have the legal right to work in Italy at the time of application.
* + You will work closely with teams in the United States and India. Most India collaboration will fit within normal Milan working hours. Some conversations with our Pacific Time teams in the US will land later in the Milan evening. Expect occasional travel within Europe and to the United States.
* Other duties as assigned

**What You Will Own**

* Requirements and the product backlog
* Program plans, dependencies, and timelines
* Business process design
* Release readiness
* Adoption and business results


You will co\-own the International Digital product roadmap together with the Digital/Engineering leader and the International Marketing leader. You will also influence product strategy, budget planning, and vendor management, working closely with the people who own those decisions.


Day\-to\-day, you will make calls on backlog priorities, scope tradeoffs, vendor coordination, release sequencing, business process recommendations, and how we manage expectations with stakeholders.

Success here is not just shipping projects on time. It shows up as:

* Strong, trusted partnerships with international business teams and with designers and engineers
* Real improvement in ecommerce adoption and customer experience
* Requirements that are clear enough to act on without back\-and\-forth
* Predictable delivery and communication people can rely on
* New country ecommerce sites and channels that launch well
* A roadmap and launch model that scale as we grow from four countries to ten and beyond
* Priorities, dependencies, risks, and expectations that are actively managed, not just tracked

* At least 10 years in product management, business analysis, or ecommerce
* Experience operating in a multi\-country or multi\-market environment where local needs must be balanced with global standards.
* Strong track record as an Ecommerce Product Manager or similar role
* Meaningful experience with B2B ecommerce
* Experience with payment processing, tax considerations, fulfillment, and order management
* A history of working with designers, engineers, business leaders, and vendors
* The ability to turn messy, complex business needs into requirements engineers can build from
* Experience managing backlogs, program plans, dependencies, and release readiness
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, including across European markets
* Strong written and spoken English
* Enough technical understanding to work well with engineers and make informed product calls, even though you do not need to be an engineer or architect yourself. This includes product\-level knowledge of analytics, payment and order processing, privacy and regulatory requirements, digital platform dependencies, ecommerce operations, and CRM\-enabled processes

* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry
* Familiarity with platforms such as BigCommerce, Salesforce CRM, NetSuite, Stripe, PayPal, Contentstack, Webflow, Google Analytics, or Segment. You do not need experience with all of them

We have that, too, and the opportunity to join an organization where our values of Grit, Impact, Fun, and Transparency are displayed daily.


Evolus takes pride in being a company on the forefront of innovation, while being committed to conducting its business with the highest degrees of integrity, professionalism, and social responsibility. Join our team at **NH Hotels \& Resorts**, a global leader in upscale and midscale hospitality, renowned for our exceptional service and facilities. A brand with a strong footprint in Europe and the Americas that is beginning its adventure in Greater China.  

You will have the opportunity to provide our guests with reliable experiences that combine value, location and your own human touch. You can join us in our quest to make every hotel stay remarkable by meeting the needs of guests looking for functional hotels \& resorts with a natural and fresh style, doubled by friendly service. Become part of a brand that is like you: Functional, natural and down\-to\-earth, innovative, reliable and friendly.

  


**What will be your mission?**

  

As a General Manager, you will lead all aspects of the hotel, ensuring operational excellence, profitability, guest and team member experience, and brand compliance.

 **What will you do?**  

* Act as the visible leader of the hotel, fostering a team and guest\-centric culture of excellence and accountability throughout the hotel.
* Directly responsible for the full management and performance of the hotel, ensuring operational efficiency, quality, and alignment with corporate objectives.
* Oversee and support the full operation and profitability of the hotel.
* Achieve the expected results in terms of the KPIs included in the Hotel Balanced Scorecard.
* Anticipate business risks and opportunities, activating timely strategic and operational responses.
* Identify and proactively raise opportunities for growth.
* Manage and coordinate the implementation of the corporate policies and projects together with the correspondent central teams (CRM \& Loyalty, Brand Strategy, PR \& Communication, Quality, Sustainable Business, etc.).
* Act as the primary relationship owner and first point of contact for the hotel owner, building long\-term trust, aligning expectations, proactively managing communication, and addressing issues to protect performance and partnership value. Coordinating the strategies and actions, when needed, with the different central services areas that could be involved.
* If required, representative when it comes to participation in local networking, associations, internal/ external meetings and industry forums.
* Ensure compliance with legal, health \& safety and regulatory requirements and standards (e.g. licenses, fire safety, legionella).

 **Revenues*** Actively drives revenue growth for the hotel, working in close partnership with Sales and Revenue teams to generate demand, optimize commercial strategies and maximize market opportunities so that the Hotel achieves Budget Sales target \& Market penetration KPI´s
* Demonstrate deep and continuous awareness of the competitive set, with strong understanding of competitors’ positioning, products, services and strategies.
* Review and challenge sales and pricing strategies to ensure alignment to ensure strong market positioning and alignment with Area/Market business priorities.
* Be accountable for the performance of the hotel’s commercial visibility, including the website, OTAs, digital presence and local marketing initiatives.
* Identify and secure local partners, alliances and initiatives that directly contribute to revenue generation and brand exposure.

 **Quality*** Own the end‑to‑end guest experience of the hotel, acting as the ultimate accountable leader for service excellence, brand delivery and guest satisfaction.
* Translate brand standards, guest feedback and quality KPIs into concrete actions that continuously enhance experiences, reputation, loyalty and repeat business.
* Reach on an annual basis the Hotel targets on Quality \& GHA members

**People*** Build, lead and develop a strong and diverse leadership team, ensuring leaders at all levels are equipped, accountable and role‑model the desired culture, behaviors and performance standards.
* Own the full team member lifecycle within the hotel, ensuring attraction, selection, onboarding, development and retention of talent, while actively contributing to internal succession and talent pipelines.
* Drive high levels of performance, engagement and accountability across the hotel, proactively addressing absenteeism and turnover through targeted action plans.

  

**Finance*** Review the P\&L of their hotel and support in establishing corrective measures to achieve the Hotel Ebitda Targets.
* Review forecasts and financial projections in line with corporate timelines.
* Responsible of the approved capex execution as well as to submit the future capex needs for the Hotel to be approved.

 **Decision Scope:**

* Own their hotel end\-to\-end performance, for operational and financial results within the budgetary framework defined by the company.
* **Decision Rights \& Escalation Framework\*:**
* **Revenues:** adjust operational and commercial levers to reach the hotel targets; escalate if necessary.
* **People:** Labor Management of their own hotel within defined decision rights and escalate high\-impact cases.
* **Finance:**
* Propose and implement improvements that lead to improve the hotel operation, ensuring efficient resource allocation and supporting the financial and quality objectives of the hotel.
* P\&L / EBITDA deviation: Proposes to the Market Director/SVP Operations corrective measures, executes them, and oversees their financial impact.
* Capex: Oversee execution to ensure approved annual investments are delivered within approved timelines and scope, escalating any risk of delay to the Market Director/SVP Operations in Europe and General Director of Operations in Americas.

* *Please, access the updated* ***approval limits*** *available within the* ***Digital Knowledge Workplace****.*

 **Core Functions:**

* **Revenues:** Work with the revenue manager and sales team to implement commercial strategies, ensuring effective oversight of the hotel’s marketing, digital presence and social media performance.
* **Quality:** Ensure brand quality standards and SOPs. Optimize lean workflows. Create guest experiences promoting guest satisfaction, aligned with brand and loyalty compliance.
* **People:** Lead the whole team member life cycle within the hotel, attracting and developing them, ensuring strong performance and engagement, and building talent pipelines.
* **Finance:** Financial Performance, P\&L \& Business Results: Own P\&L delivery and activate corrective playbooks. Propose Capex opportunities and oversee execution under investment governance.

 **Reporting Structure:**

* Reports to the Market Director or SVP Operations in Europe, and to the General Managing Directors in Americas.
* Leads the hotel team.

 **What are we looking for?**  

* At least 2 years of experience in a senior hotel leadership role (e.g. General Manager, Hotel Manager, Deputy Hotel Director or similar), managing complex operations and diverse teams
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, with solid P\&L management and revenue\-driving experience
* Strategic mindset with the ability to make high\-impact decisions and drive business performance
* Strong leadership capabilities, with a track record of building, engaging and developing high\-performing teams
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including ownership and corporate relations
* Solid understanding of hotel operations, guest experience and brand standards
* International experience is highly valued
* Fluent in English and local language; additional languages are a strong asset
* Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration or related field

 **Compensation**  

Gross annual salary starting from 65K.
Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, skills and level of seniority. **Why choose us?**  

At Minor Hotels Europe \& Americas, we are committed to supporting internal development and mobility, enabling our team members to grow professionally within the group, either within the same country or internationally.
We provide a people\-centred environment where learning, wellbeing and mobility are real and supported opportunities, aligned with both individual career paths and business needs. **What you can expect** **Competitive conditions*** Salary aligned with your experience, responsibilities and local market conditions.
* Bonus or incentive schemes, depending on the level of the position.
* Additional local benefits such as meal vouchers, staff canteen

  

**Career development opportunities** with national and international challenges across hotels and brands.**A wide range of training and development programmes** through Minor Hotels University, supporting internal growth and professional mobility.**Wellbeing initiatives****Team member recognition programmes**, including Memorable Dates.**The opportunity to contribute to sustainability and volunteering initiatives**, making a positive impact beyond our hotels.**Team member rates and promotions**, offering discounted rates in our hotels around the world and exclusive benefits through our corporate loyalty programme.  

Senior leadership roles benefit from a more comprehensive mobility framework, supporting both business priorities and long\-term careers within the group. For national or international appointments, support may include:  

* Relocation and housing support during the transition phase.
* Moving and travel assistance, according to the type of assignment.
* Tailored international allowance packages for long\-term assignments.
* Support for family needs, where applicable and covered by policy.
* Structured return, localization or onward\-mobility planning, ensuring career continuity.


Mobility at this level is designed as a strategic step within a broader leadership journey at Minor Hotels.  

If you are looking for your next professional challenge and are open to mobility, this opportunity allows you to continue growing within Minor Hotels, supported by clear conditions, structured processes and a long\-term career perspective. **Are you looking for a new challenge?** **Apply now!**

title: Clinical Field Service Engineer
description:
Overview:
* Are you looking for an impactful role within a growing business that helps advance science and improve human health?
* Would you enjoy the freedom of a field\-based role where no two days are the same and you can become a trusted technical partner to our customers?
* Are you looking for opportunities to grow, develop, learn and progress in your career?
* Would you like to join a global, innovative technology organisation that is strongly committed to diversity, equity and inclusion?


If your answers are yes, then we would love to hear from you!  

At Waters, we design and manufacture innovative products, solutions and services that help our customers solve important scientific challenges. Our people make a real difference through their work. They are passionate about what they do, proud of their accomplishments and central to making Waters a great place to work.  

As a **Clinical Field Service Engineer**, you will support customers operating Waters LC\-MS systems within regulated clinical laboratory environments. This is a varied and rewarding field\-based role in which you will install, maintain and repair analytical systems, solve technical problems and build trusted relationships with the customers you support. No two days will be the same.  

As a global organisation, Waters offers a wide range of opportunities to learn, grow and develop. Many of our team members have progressed within Field Service or moved into other areas of the business, including applications support, sales, global technical support and leadership.  


Responsibilities:
**So, what does a Clinical Field Service Engineer do? Below are some of the key responsibilities:*** Install, qualify, calibrate, maintain, troubleshoot and repair Waters LC\-MS systems within regulated clinical laboratory environments.
* Analyse system performance and diagnostic data to identify the source of technical problems and determine the appropriate corrective action.
* Work closely with our wider technical and support teams to resolve issues efficiently, escalating more complex problems when required.
* Manage customer expectations by clearly communicating the work performed and providing follow\-up plans where required.
* Complete service records and other required documentation accurately and promptly, in accordance with Waters’ quality and regulatory procedures.
* Build strong relationships with customers, providing appropriate advice and support on Waters products and services while identifying opportunities to further improve their laboratory operations.


To help you succeed, you will receive comprehensive technical training, support from an experienced team and access to continuous learning and development opportunities throughout your career at Waters.
Qualifications:
**Who are we looking for?** **Education:*** A minimum bachelor’s degree in analytical chemistry, biology, physics, engineering or a related scientific or technical discipline is essential.

**Experience:*** Practical experience working with complex analytical or laboratory instrumentation.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, fluidic and software\-related issues.
* Experience maintaining, calibrating or troubleshooting analytical instrumentation would be advantageous.
* Previous experience using or servicing LC\-MS instrumentation, preferably Waters systems, is strongly preferred.
* Experience within a clinical, forensic, hospital, IVD or other regulated laboratory environment would be advantageous.
* A valid driving licence in good standing is mandatory.
* Willingness to undertake overnight travel when required, including international travel for technical training.

**Skills:*** A strong customer focus and commitment to delivering excellent service.
* A logical and analytical approach to troubleshooting and problem\-solving.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues from different technical backgrounds.
* The ability to manage time effectively, organise field activities and work independently.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to work with wider technical and support teams.
* A strong sense of personal integrity and accountability
* Fluent Italian and a good professional command of spoken and written English, equivalent to at least B2 under the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). The role requires regular communication with an English\-speaking manager and international colleagues, as well as participation in technical training delivered in English.

 **Frequent overnight travel may be required.**  

Waters recognises that people from some backgrounds remain under\-represented within STEM careers and may face barriers during the application process. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from everyone. You do not need to meet every desirable requirement of the role. If you believe you can add value to our business, we want to hear from you.
Company Description:

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of \~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.  

  

Within Waters’ Advanced Diagnostics group, the Clinical LC\-MS Service team supports analytical systems used in regulated clinical laboratory environments. As a Clinical Field Service Engineer, you will install, maintain and repair Waters LC\-MS systems, helping customers maintain reliable operation and deliver high\-quality diagnostic testing. *Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business needs.*

title: Global Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Who we are

**Amplifon** is an Italian multinational company and the global leader in hearing care solutions and services, built on retail expertise, customization and consumer care. More than **20,000 professionals** every day, in a network of 10,000 points of sale across **25 countries**, give back the joy of hearing, feeling and living to thousands of people across the world.

Role Overview


At Amplifon we are evolving our technological infrastructure and elevating our security posture, integrating cutting\-edge innovations into our operational cybersecurity framework. As we prioritize innovative services for delivering hearing healthcare, robust cybersecurity is critical to ensure the security and integrity of these systems. In parallel, we are modernizing our internal asset management processes, leveraging digital tools for comprehensive, end\-to\-end life\-cycle management.


We are looking for a talented Global Cybersecurity Specialist to join our Global IT \- Cyber Security team. Reporting to the Global Cyber Security Associate Director, you will work hands\-on across penetration testing, infrastructure and application security assessment, vulnerability management and security\-platform operations. You will also take an active part in security monitoring and incident response, and contribute to our information security governance program (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2\).


This is a high\-impact, cross\-country role in a fast\-moving environment, where your work directly protects customer data and business\-critical services and helps shape our asset management strategy.


Key Responsibilities


Offensive Security \& Assessments

* **Penetration testing \& assessment \-** plan and perform penetration tests and security assessments on web and mobile applications, internal systems and internet\-facing infrastructure, identifying vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and exposure (e.g. unmanaged accounts, weak authentication, unnecessary services, exposed personal data).
* **Remediation ownership \-** produce clear, risk\-based reports and drive remediation with system, application and infrastructure owners through to closure, then re\-test to confirm fixes are effective.
* **Controlled validation \-** support authorized, red\-team\-style validation activities (e.g. credential/dump validation, lateral\-movement checks) to confirm real\-world exploitability.

  

Vulnerability Management  

* **Lifecycle management \-** run and continuously mature the vulnerability management lifecycle: discovery, triage, prioritization, remediation tracking and verification.
* **Strategy \-** collaborate in the development and execution of robust vulnerability management strategies across the global estate.

  

Security Platforms \& Infrastructure  

* **Platform operations \-** operate, configure and tune security consoles and platforms across endpoint, network and identity \- for example EDR (e.g. SentinelOne), endpoint and patch management (e.g. Ivanti) and network security / firewalls (e.g. Cisco ASA) \- ensuring compliance with company policies and industry best practice.
* **Access \& credential hygiene \-** strengthen access and credential hygiene on shared and critical systems (account reviews, deprovisioning of stale users, credential rotation, reduction of data exposure).

  

Security Monitoring \& Incident Response  

* **Detection \& response \-** contribute to security monitoring and to the detection, analysis, containment and recovery phases of security incidents, working alongside the SOC and specialized external partners (e.g. threat\-intelligence and incident\-response providers).
* **Post\-incident hardening \-** support lessons\-learned and hardening activities to reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

  

Governance, Risk \& Compliance  

* **ISMS \& regulation \-** contribute to the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001\), information security risk assessments and regulatory alignment (e.g. NIS2\), keeping security practices consistent with company policies.

  

Asset Management, KPIs \& Suppliers  

* **Asset lifecycle \& KPIs \-** support asset life\-cycle management and endpoint standardization initiatives using digital tools, and identify and track KPIs relevant to a secure, well\-governed asset and vulnerability portfolio.
* **Supplier management \-** oversee the engagement and management of external suppliers and partners (penetration testing, vulnerability and security services), managing scope, quality and delivery against organizational expectations.

  

Requirements
Must have

  

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM field with a focus on cybersecurity or a related discipline \- or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* Solid understanding of penetration testing tools and methodologies (network and web/mobile application testing; familiarity with frameworks such as OWASP).
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management, security assessment techniques and common attack techniques (e.g. authentication weaknesses, credential attacks such as pass\-the\-hash, lateral movement).
* Experience with security platforms across endpoint, network and identity (e.g. EDR, endpoint/patch management, firewalls).
* Awareness of information security frameworks and regulations (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, GDPR / personal\-data protection).
* Proactive mindset, dedicated to continuous improvement and adept at navigating transformational initiatives.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a meticulous, process\-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced, multi\-country environment while managing multiple priorities concurrently.
* Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative, team\-oriented attitude.
* Fluency in English is mandatory.

  

Nice to have  

* Industry certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GIAC, CompTIA Security\+ or equivalent.
* Scripting and automation skills (e.g. Python, PowerShell, Bash).
* Exposure to cloud security (Azure / AWS / GCP) and Active Directory security.
* Prior experience in complex IT projects or within high\-growth, multi\-country contexts.
* Working proficiency in Italian is a plus for our Milan\-based Global IT team.

**Location**: HQ Milan, Italy (Hybrid \- allowing employees to work 6 days per month remotely)

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Applicable Collective Agreement:** CCNL Commercio (Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi)

**Contractual Level:** Employee (1\-2\) level

**Contract Type:** Permanent \- Full Time


The reference Gross Annual Salary is approximately in the range of €34\.500 \- €48\.000\. The actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and specific skills and knowledge and also to the educational background.


The position is also eligible for an annual Company bonus ('premio di risultato') linked to business performance, in line with Company policies.

**Benefits**  



* €750 Annual Welfare plan for your personal well\-being across a wide range of services
* **Health Insurance:** Fondo Est healthcare coverage \+ an additional Accident Insurance
* **Supplementary pension scheme:** option to enrol in the Fondo Fon.Te with employer contributions
* **Office Perks:** On\-site canteen and free company parking
* **BeWellProgram:** Free access to learning platforms and training programs. We invest in your growth through ongoing learning opportunities, while also offering special corporate discounts, dedicated services for you and your loved ones, and initiatives focused on your wellbeing and physical health

  

**Equal Opportunities Statement**
Amplifon is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a diverse and equitable workforce environment. We believe that through valuing our uniqueness and respecting our differences, we can achieve more, and that diversity adds to our culture. We encourage applications from all genders, corners of the world and individual backgrounds

description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

### **THE ROLE**



Director of Specialty Fibers



This role ensures that every product made from cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, and other luxury fibers meets Quince's uncompromising standards for quality, sustainability, and affordability.



The Director blends deep technical expertise in fiber science with strategic supply chain leadership and cross\-functional collaboration, serving as the central hub connecting sourcing, production, quality, and design teams across global markets.


### **Responsibilities**


#### **Strategic Leadership \& Supply Chain Management**


* Orchestrate the end\-to\-end supply chain as the central hub connecting sourcing managers, production teams, and quality specialists to ensure a seamless, resilient, and efficient flow from fiber to finished yarn.
* Lead and mentor a diverse, specialized team of sourcing managers, quality engineers, and production experts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Drive multi\-sourcing and nearshoring strategies to mitigate geopolitical and logistical risks while ensuring a stable supply of high\-grade fibers from the Americas and Asia.
* Set the strategic direction for vertical integration opportunities, evaluating build\-vs\-buy decisions for spinning, dyeing, or finishing capabilities that could enhance quality control and margin structure.
* Act as a key advisor to the executive team on fiber market trends, geopolitical risks (e.g., trade tariffs, export restrictions), climate impacts on raw material supply, and competitive intelligence—translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.
* Champion Quince's "unreal prices" mission by continuously identifying cost\-leadership opportunities across the supply chain, from farm to finished yarn, without compromising ethical standards or product integrity.

#### **Sourcing \& Supplier Development**


* Build and curate a best\-in\-class supplier ecosystem, identifying, vetting, and onboarding mills, dehairers, spinners, and dye houses that meet Quince's exacting standards for quality, capacity, sustainability, and labor practices.
* Lead supplier development programs, coaching strategic partners to improve yield, reduce defects, adopt sustainable practices, and achieve cost efficiencies that benefit both parties.
* Drive traceability and transparency across the entire fiber supply chain, from herder cooperatives and farms to finished yarn. Partner with certification bodies (GOTS, RWS, GCS, ZQ) to ensure chain\-of\-custody integrity.
* Make high\-stakes sourcing decisions based on deep market intelligence—including auction prices, crop forecasts, currency fluctuations, and geopolitical developments—balancing short\-term cost opportunities with long\-term relationship value.

#### **Quality Assurance \& Technical Optimization**


* Architect the quality management system for all specialty fibers, defining standards, testing protocols, and approval workflows for raw fiber, dehaired fiber, tops, yarns, and finished goods.
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Natural Fibers Quality to establish measurable quality benchmarks, including micron distribution, fiber length, tensile strength, yield, color fastness, and pilling resistance—ensuring every lot meets or exceeds luxury brand parity.
* Oversee third\-party lab testing and compliance, working with the Cashmere Spec/Test Report/Compliance Auditor to validate that all materials meet international standards (ISO, OEKO\-TEX, GOTS, REACH) and Quince's internal specifications.
* Lead root\-cause analysis for quality failures, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across the supply chain. Drive a culture of "quality at the source," empowering suppliers to self\-detect and correct issues before production.
* Collaborate with product development and design teams to translate aesthetic and tactile visions into technical specifications—micron targets, twist levels, finishing treatments—that are manufacturable at scale and cost.

  


#### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Serve as the central point of communication for all fiber\-related matters, providing technical expertise and clear direction to design, product development, and production teams.
* Communicate daily with domestic and overseas mills, dye houses, and suppliers to give precise, actionable feedback on fiber quality, color accuracy, availability and production timelines.
* Translate design and merchandising visions into clear, manufacturable technical briefs for suppliers, ensuring that product aesthetics and performance meet Quince's brand standards.
* Lead blind panels with design, merchandising, and customer focus groups to validate luxury fiber perception and color accuracy before commercialization.


### **Qualifications**


#### **Required**


* Degree in Textile Science, Fiber Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain Management, Color Chemistry, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in specialty fiber sourcing, yarn production, quality management, or coloration for apparel, accessories, or home textiles.
* Deep technical knowledge of natural fibers (cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, cotton), spinning processes (woolen, worsted)
* Proven leadership experience managing cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced retail or manufacturing environment, with a track record of mentoring and developing talent.
* Strong cost analysis skills: cost\-per\-kilogram modeling, yield optimization, landed cost analysis, and budget management.
* Experience building and maintaining quality standards, and supplier compliance programs, including SKU rationalization and shade consolidation.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.

#### **Preferred**


* Experience with sustainable fibers
* Knowledge of supply chain traceability including blockchain or digital tracking systems.
* Familiarity with PLM systems and quality database management.
* Background in luxury goods (apparel, home and accessories) with an eye for premium aesthetics, handfeel, and trend forecasting.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**

description:
**Job Description****Who we are**


Amplifon is an Italian multinational company and the global leader in hearing care solutions and services. More than 20,000 professionals every day, in a network of 9,500 points of sale across 24 countries, give back the joy of hearing, feeling and living to thousands of people across the world.


We believe people are the most important component of our success, and that it is only through strong investment in talent, continuous development, support and recognition that our people can exceed every limit and build a fulfilling career. Aligned to our Winning Workplace, we offer a hybrid working policy allowing employees to work 6 days/month remotely.

**Role Purpose**


Amplifon is looking for a **Global Security Operations Manager** to lead the day\-to\-day execution of the Group's Security Operations, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, response and continuous improvement of cybersecurity capabilities across a multinational environment.


Reporting to the **Group Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)**, the Global Security Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating internal cybersecurity specialists and managed security partners (SOC/MDR, NDR, endpoint protection, incident response providers and specialist vendors), ensuring efficient and resilient security operations on a global scale.


The role combines operational leadership with strong technical expertise, driving continuous improvement across security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management and security platform operations while operating within the Group's governance and compliance framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Operations**

  

* Manage the daily execution of the Group Security Operations across endpoint, network, identity and cloud environments.
* Coordinate the Security Operations Center (SOC) and Managed Detection \& Response (MDR) services, ensuring service quality and adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Improve detection capabilities by developing and maintaining SIEM use cases, playbooks and security automation initiatives.
* Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  

**Incident Response \& Cyber Resilience**  

* Coordinate the end\-to\-end incident response process, including preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery and post\-incident reviews.
* Manage major security incidents in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external incident response partners.
* Drive remediation activities and support initiatives aimed at strengthening cyber resilience and operational readiness.

  

**Vulnerability \& Threat Management**  

* Manage the vulnerability management lifecycle, including identification, prioritization, remediation tracking and validation.
* Support threat intelligence activities and exposure management initiatives to prioritize security risks.
* Coordinate penetration testing and security assessment activities with infrastructure and application teams.

  

**Security Engineering \& Platform Operations**  

* Oversee the operational management and continuous improvement of the Group's security technologies, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, email security, firewalls, MFA and privileged access management.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to implement secure configurations and security\-by\-design principles.

  

**Vendor \& Team Coordination**  

* Coordinate a team of security specialists, supporting their development and ensuring effective collaboration across countries.
* Manage relationships with managed security service providers and specialist vendors, monitoring service performance, escalations and operational deliverables.

  

**Reporting \& Planning**  

* Monitor operational KPIs, SLAs and security metrics, providing regular reporting to the Group CISO.
* Support budget planning, capacity planning and continuous improvement initiatives within the Security Operations function.

  

**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**  

* Ensure Security Operations activities comply with the Group Information Security Management System (ISMS), ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2 and applicable regulations.
* Support internal and external audits and contribute to maintaining compliance with security policies and standards.

  

**Candidate Profile****Experience**

  

* 6\-8 years of experience in cybersecurity, including significant experience in Security Operations, SOC or Incident Response environments.
* Previous experience managing security operations teams or coordinating technical cybersecurity professionals.
* Experience working with Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) and external security vendors.
* Experience handling cybersecurity incidents and coordinating response activities.
* Exposure to multinational and complex enterprise environments is preferred.

  

**Technical Skills**  

* Strong knowledge of Security Operations technologies, including SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, threat intelligence and incident response.
* Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and/or GCP) and identity security.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards including ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, GDPR and NIST.

  

**Leadership \& Soft Skills**  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to prioritize activities and manage multiple initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
* Collaborative leadership style and ability to work across international teams.

  

**Education \& Certifications**  

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity or equivalent experience.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or similar are considered a plus.
* Fluency in English is mandatory; Italian is a plus.

**What We Offer**

  

* The opportunity to contribute to the security operations of a leading global company operating across 24 countries.
* Close collaboration with the Group CISO and international technology teams.

**Location**: HQ Milan, Italy (Hybrid \- allowing employees to work 6 days per month remotely)


**Compensation \& Benefits**


**Applicable Collective Agreement**: CCNL Commercio (Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi)


**Contractual Level**:Quadro

**Contract Type**: Permanent \- Full Time


The reference **Gross Annual Salary** is approximately in the range of EUR 70\.000 \- 92\.000 . The actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and specific skills and knowledge and also to the educational background.


The position is also eligible for an annual incentive scheme based on Company and individual performance KPIs, with a payout whose target is equal to 15% of the annual gross salary, in line with Company policies.


**Benefits**  

  



* **€1,700 Annual Welfare plan** for your personal well\-being on a wide range of services
* **Health Insurance: QUAS** healthcare coverage and an additional company integrative insurance \+ Accident Insurance
* **Supplementary pension scheme:**option to enrol in the Fondo Fon.Te with employer contributions
* **Office Perks:**On\-site **canteen**and free **company parking**
* **BeWellProgram:**Free access to learning platforms and training programs. We invest in your growth through ongoing learning opportunities, while also offering special corporate discounts, dedicated services for you and your loved ones, and initiatives focused on your wellbeing and physical health
* 6 days of remote working per month.

**Equal Opportunities Statement**


Amplifon is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a diverse and equitable workforce environment. We believe that through valuing our uniqueness and respecting our differences, we can achieve more, and that diversity adds to our culture. We encourage applications from all genders, corners of the world and individual backgrounds.
